## W-002 Missed-Call Lead Response

**Purpose:** verified missed-call event -> consent-aware branded text-back with human escalation.

**SAFE MODE:** ships with DRY_RUN=true. Nothing can send until you complete A2P 10DLC registration, wire a provider credential in the Send node, and deliberately flip DRY_RUN.

**Controls:** signature presence check, tenant mapping, missed-only filter, idempotency vs provider retries, suppression check before send (fails CLOSED), quiet hours, approved template only.
